messages.subject: Problem Renaming and exporting Images
parts:
Hi everyone! My name is Antonio. First I want to thank you, Juergen, for your tireless work helping the package users.

Here I found a problem with one of my camera traps. Only one.

Here is what I did:

> wd_images_raw <- file.path('/Volumes/Brother/PhD Wolves /Geraldine Data/RawDataCams3')
> wd_images_raw_renamed <- file.path('/Volumes/Brother/PhD Wolves/Geraldine Data/RawDataCamsRenamed3')
> renaming.table5 <- imageRename(inDir               = wd_images_raw,
+                                outDir              = wd_images_raw_renamed,
+                                hasCameraFolders    = FALSE,
+                                copyImages          = TRUE,
+                                
+ )
Warning: found 138 JPG files beginning with '._' in /Volumes/Brother/PhD Wolves /Geraldine Data/RawDataCams3/Cam54 .
These images will be ignored.
Cam54:  138 images      |====================|  100%
Error: No new images to be copied. Exiting.

Where it says No New Images to be COpied, There are 138 pictures to be imported but none of them is being copied. It creates the R Object (renaming.table5), but it does not copy the files with the new name on them.


The files are not beginning with '._' and I even tried to rename them manually.

Does anyone know what I'm missing? Is there anything I can do to fix this?

I have read somewhere that it could be related to using IOS and IOS formatting, but I do not understand why only happened in this Cam54.

Thank you in advance!

Antonio

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Problem Renaming and exporting Images
parts:
Hi Antonio,
and apologies for the extremely late reply.
The files beginning with "._" are specific to iOS and are listed by list.files() in R, which causes problems. See
https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/invisible-files-with-prefix-are-created-on-some-shared-volumes-and-external-disks/

I am not familiar with iOS, so I can't say why it only happens in one station.

The other message about "no new images to be copied" means that the 138 images you wish to copy already exist in the new location " wd_images_raw_renamed " and are therefore not copied.
Best regards,
Jürgen
